  - button "Open menu" [e18]
  - strong: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth
  - text: We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €30 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.
  - strong: What You’ll Do
  - list:
    - listitem: Own the quality assurance tasks for multiple projects, ensuring that the software meets the highest standards of quality and reliability
    - listitem: Actively participate in design and requirements reviews to ensure testability and usability of features and products
    - listitem: Lead testing efforts, including developing and maintaining automation frameworks and scripts
    - listitem: Plan, implement and execute testing tasks in different product areas - DB, integration, functional, UI/UX
    - listitem: Analyse test results to identify areas for improvement and recommend process changes as needed
    - listitem: Provide technical and process mentorship to less experienced colleagues
    - listitem: Work in compact, autonomous teams with short release cycles - we rely on agile, independent teams of sharp and driven people with just the right amount of processes to steer off anarchy and not sacrifice velocity
  - strong: What You Need To Have
  - list:
    - listitem: 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on automation testing
    - listitem: Strong understanding of software testing concepts, methodologies, and tools
    - listitem: Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (Python, TypeScript, Java, etc.)
    - listitem: Experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g. Playwright, Selenium, Appium, Pytest, TestNG, etc.)
    - listitem: Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar
    - listitem: Strong RDBMS knowledge
    - listitem: Familiarity with agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban
    - listitem: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    - listitem: A very good command of English and excellent communication skills
    - listitem: Passion for quality assurance
  - strong: Nice to have
  - list:
    - listitem: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related field
    - listitem: Experience with testing microservices and distributed systems
    - listitem: Experience in testing mobile applications
    - listitem: Experience with NoSQL DB
    - listitem: Experience with Event Stream Processing platforms
  - strong: What We Offer
  - list:
    - listitem: Challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast
    - listitem: Opportunity to make a big Impact - you'll be involved in developing cutting-edge services used by millions of investors to build wealth
    - listitem: Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high-performing colleagues toward a common goal
    - listitem: Appreciation for your talent and ideas
    - listitem: Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses
    - listitem: Excellent social benefits package, including private health insurance, sports card and 25 days of paid vacation per year
    - listitem: Delicious treats and a spacious game room
  - text: Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!
